audit.whatIsWrong: CROSS-LAYER DISAGREEMENT on four rows: full-layer phases[0..6].side was "Skill" straight down, while content read Lux, Lux, Skill, Skill, Vex, Skill, Vex.
audit.why: The packet levelChart matches the content layer exactly. The shape is right too: Lux's 1175 root threat owns levels 1-2 before Doom 'n Gloom matters, the lane levels off at 3-5, and Vex takes 6 and the late game on Shadow Surge (140/120/100s, 2000/2500/3000 range, recast dash, resets on takedown) plus a fear that interrupts Final Spark's channel.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side and phases[1].side moved to Lux; phases[4].side and phases[6].side moved to Vex with both whys rewritten to describe Vex winning those stages. Rows 2, 3 and 5 already agreed on Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 and 2+ items whys both described LUX spiking, on rows the data assigns to Vex.
audit.why: Vex's level-6 spike is the real one in this lane: Shadow Surge marks from 2000 range at rank 1 and recasts into a dash, so she opens on Lux from outside Lux's 1175 Q. Late, it resets on takedown. Lux's counter-spikes (Final Spark 60/50/40s, Luden's) hold rows 0-1 and 5, not 4 and 6.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why and phases[6].why rewritten to state Shadow Surge's range, recast and reset.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text and early both claimed Lux out-ranges Vex. Mistral Bolt is 1200 range; Lux's Q is 1175 and her E 1100. Vex out-ranges Lux, not the other way round. breakdown.cooldowns also carried no number.
audit.why: The real edge is not range, it is the shape of the trade: Personal Space is a 475-range shield on 16/15/14/13/12s and Looming Darkness is 800 on a flat 12s, so both of Vex's answers are short and countable, while Mistral Bolt (8s to 4s) is pure chip. Separately, half of Doom 'n Gloom is inert here — the mark procs on nearby enemies who DASH, and Lux has no dash to give her. What does apply is the fear interrupting Final Spark's channel.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text and early now state the real 1200-vs-1175 relationship; cooldowns now carries 16s/12s Personal Space, 8s-to-4s Mistral Bolt and 140s Shadow Surge; wants.you[1] now names the dead dash-mark.
